name: fp-with-ts-hands-on
description: 関数型ドメインモデリングハンズオン with TypeScript のサンプルコードとドキュメントサイト

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/clinic-web build && pnpm --filter './examples/session-*' build && pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/clinic-final build && pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/docs build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/clinic-web test && pnpm --filter './examples/session-*' test && pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/clinic-final test && pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/docs test && pnpm test:worker
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/clinic-web typecheck && pnpm --filter './examples/session-*' typecheck && pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/clinic-final typecheck && pnpm --filter @fp-with-ts/docs typecheck && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit
